run_pipeline_zero1to3: run the Zero1to3 pipeline to generate novel views from a single input image and pose parameters
create_cc_projection: create a CCProjection module that projects concatenated CLIP features and pose embeddings to the original CLIP feature size
encode_image_with_pose: encode an input image with pose embeddings using CLIP features and the CCProjection layer for classifier-free guidance
prepare_img_latents: prepare VAE-encoded image latents from input images for conditioning the diffusion denoising loop
encode_pose_embeddings: encode pose parameters (elevation, azimuth, distance) into pose embeddings with sin/cos transformations for diffusion conditioning
